svg.aria-label: Shared API: product request, connector execution and result
svg.title: Shared API: product request, connector execution and result
svg.desc: Same Sage API contract for product, authorised provider and connector roles; external platform calls are separate. Solid arrows are requests; dashed arrows are paired responses. Grey bars show handling intervals, not duration. Solid: requests. Dashed: paired technical responses. Grey bars: handling intervals, not elapsed time. Blue: proposed operation mapping under the confirmed common API direction. A direct provider executor uses this same API contract; only one executor may send each action.
svg.text: Shared API: product request, connector execution and result
Same Sage API contract for product, authorised provider and connector roles; external platform calls are separate
Red: Open / Assumption / Gap / Source conflict
ref | A · Accept authorised work or stop before an external effect
opt | B · Connector is the selected executor; known external response
opt | Reconciliation query is qualified and current authority permits access
opt | C · Alternative: possible external effect, lost response or failed local evidence save
The E-Invoice Service participant exposes the shared API. Call labels are logical until mapped to the actual
version; no separate Provider Connector API is introduced.
If reconciliation is unsupported, blocked or inconclusive, hold the original work for its owner. Retry lost
shared-API submissions under the same identity; do not repeat the external mutation merely to recover local
Publish saved work for the assigned
No fresh send or automatic failover
Same shared API and original action
Evidence recorded or held for owner
Solid: requests. Dashed: paired technical responses. Grey bars: handling intervals, not elapsed time.
Blue: proposed operation mapping under the confirmed common API direction. A direct provider executor uses this same API contract; only one executor may send each action.
